mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past 2 months signals increased demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 2 months signals increased economic activity and supply-side strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and stimulates economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the past month, it signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) increase by more than 2% over the past 2 months and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points, it signals strong consumer demand and a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 2% in 2 months and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized over the past 3 months, it signals accommodative monetary policy with inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2% and CPIAUCSL > 2% annualized increase in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
